name: Second conditional
summary: Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy, nohaqiqiy va amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan vaziyatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Hozirgi paytda haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan orzular yoki xayollarni aytishda.

example.en: If I had a million dollars, I would buy a big house.
example.uz: Agar menda bir million dollar bo'lganida edi, katta uy sotib olgan bo'lar edim.

usage.text: Boshqa biror insonning o'rnida bo'lganda nima qilishni tasavvur qilishda.

example.en: If I were you, I would study harder.
example.uz: Agar men sening o'rningda bo'lganimda, qattiqroq o'qigan bo'lar edim.

usage.text: Real bo'lmagan shart va uning natijasini ko'rsatishda.

example.en: If it stopped raining, we would go out.
example.uz: Agar yomg'ir to'xtaganda edi, biz ko'chaga chiqqan bo'lar edik.

structure.formula: If + Past Simple, Subject + would + V1

example.en: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
example.uz: Agar lotereyada yutsam, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilgan bo'lar edim.

structure.formula: If + Past Simple (didn't), Subject + wouldn't + V1

example.en: If I didn't know you, I wouldn't trust you.
example.uz: Agar seni tanimaganimda, senga ishonmagan bo'lar edim.

structure.formula: Would + Subject + V1 + if + Past Simple?

example.en: What would you do if you saw a bear?
example.uz: Agar ayiqni ko'rganingda nima qilgan bo'lar eding?

structure.formula: Yes, Subject + would / No, Subject + wouldn't

example.en: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.
example.uz: Ha, qilgan bo'lar edim. / Yo'q, qilmagan bo'lar edim.

tip: Eslatma: Ikkinchi conditionalda 'I', 'he', 'she', 'it' olmoshlaridan keyin 'was' o'rniga ko'pincha rasmiy tilda 'were' ishlatiladi (masalan: If I were...).

name: Past perfect
summary: O'tgan zamondagi biror harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lib bo'lgan ish-harakatni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: O'tgan zamondagi ikkita harakatdan qaysi biri oldinroq bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun.

example.en: When I arrived, the train had left.
example.uz: Men kelganimda, poyezd ketib bo'lgandi.

usage.text: O'tgan zamondagi ma'lum bir vaqtgacha bajarilgan ishlar haqida gapirganda.

example.en: She had finished her homework by 8 PM.
example.uz: U kechqurun soat 8 gacha uy vazifasini tugatib qo'ygan edi.

example.en: He was happy because he had passed the exam.
example.uz: U xursand edi, chunki imtihondan o'tgan edi.

example.en: They had cleaned the house before guests came.
example.uz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin ular uyni tozalab qo'yishgan edi.

example.en: I hadn't seen him for five years.
example.uz: Men uni besh yildan beri ko'rmagan edim.

example.en: Had you eaten lunch before you went out?
example.uz: Ko'chaga chiqishdan oldin tushlik qilganmidingiz?

structure.formula: Yes, Subject + had / No, Subject + hadn't

example.en: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't.
example.uz: Ha, qilgan edim. / Yo'q, qilmagan edim.

tip: Eslatma: Past Simple o'tgan zamondagi oddiy ketma-ketlikni ko'rsatadi, Past Perfect эsa o'sha voqeadan 'oldinroq' sodir bo'lgan ishni ko'rsatadi.

name: after / before / because with past perfect
name_uz: Past perfect bilan after, before, because bog'lovchilari
summary: O'tgan zamonda sodir bo'lgan voqealarning ketma-ketligini aniq ko'rsatish uchun bog'lovchilar bilan Past Perfect zamonini ishlatamiz.

usage.text: Biror ish boshqasidan keyin sodir bo'lganini 'after' yordamida ko'rsatishda.

example.en: After she had eaten dinner, she washed the dishes.
example.uz: U kechki ovqatni yeb bo'lgach, idishlarni yuvdi.

usage.text: Biror ish boshqasidan oldin qilinganini 'before' yordamida ko'rsatishda.

example.en: They had locked the door before they went to sleep.
example.uz: Ular uxlashga ketishdan oldin eshikni qulflab qo'yishgandi.

usage.text: O'tgan zamondagi sababni ko'rsatish uchun 'because' dan foydalanganda.

example.en: Tom failed the test because he hadn't studied.
example.uz: Tom testdan yiqildi, chunki u o'qimagan edi.

structure.formula: After + Past Perfect, Past Simple / Past Simple + because + Past Perfect

example.en: After I had finished work, I went home.
example.uz: Ishni tugatganimdan keyin uyga ketdim.

structure.formula: Before + Past Simple, Past Perfect (negative structure)

example.en: Before we left, the rain hadn't stopped.
example.uz: Biz ketishimizdan oldin yomg'ir to'xtamagan edi.

example.en: Did you call him after you had arrived?
example.uz: Yetib kelganingizdan keyin unga qo'ng'iroq qildingizmi?

structure.formula: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

example.en: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
example.uz: Ha, qildim. / Yo'q, qilmadim.

tip: Eslatma: 'After' so'zidan keyin odatda Past Perfect keladi, 'Before' so'zidan keyin esa Past Simple keladi. Buni adashtirmang!
